initial.name: skill
initial.description: Load the full instructions for a skill. Call it before acting on a task that names or clearly matches a skill in the session skill catalog.

name.description: The exact skill name from the available skills list.

initial.name: ssh_execute_propose
initial.description: Propose one exact SSH command for approval. The receipt is not execution; the user reviews the exact command on the trusted approval page.

connectionId.description: The exact connectionId UUID from one pinned SSH connection in the system instructions. Supply only that UUID, without username, host or port.

command.description: The exact SSH command to review, at most 16 KiB.

initial.name: trial_notes_append
initial.description: Propose one note for this user in the controlled remote trial API. The call only saves an approval request; it does not write the note. Tell the user to review the exact text in the trusted approval page. Do not repeat a pending request.

text.description: The exact note text to submit for human approval, up to 1000 characters.

initial.name: trial_notes_list
initial.description: List this user's notes from the controlled remote trial API. This is a read-only network call and needs no sandbox.
